result.description:
Assertiv is an IT Security company specialising in Identity related solutions, support, training and managed services. We are currently looking for a talented IDAM Security Engineer with a background in designing, developing, implementing and supporting Identity Security solutions.

We are seeking candidates who possess good technical knowledge and experience with Opentext NetIQ Identity Governance, Silverfort Identity Security Platform, Microsoft Entra ID and related technologies and are willing to do the hard yards when it comes to delivering successful outcomes for our customers. In return, we will provide you with training across a variety of products, on-site (or remote) customer experience, and the support of a great team to help you further develop your skills and experience in IT Security.

Role Description

This role will engage in workforce and customer Identity related projects and undertake the following project-based activities:

· Install and configure Workforce and Customer Identity products.

· Install and configure Identity Security products including ISPM and ITDR.

· Develop integrations between Identity systems and business applications, specifically onboarding applications to Identity Governance systems.

· Conduct functional testing and undertake code fixes as required.

· Assist with System, Integration, Performance and User Acceptance Testing.

· Assist with documentation (Solution Design, Test Cases, Deployment Guides, As-built documents).

· Develop drivers and connectors for connected applications.

· Design and implement single sign-on using open standards (OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, WS-FED).

· Design and implement advanced authentication processes (Multi-Factor, Risk Based Auth).

· Assist with handover and/or training to customer BAU/Operations teams.

· Provide ongoing solution support for customer implementations.


We are looking for candidates with the following attributes and experience:

· University graduated, with coursework around software development, computer networks, and web development.

· Two or more years of professional work experience with Workforce and/or Customer Identity related products such as NetIQ, Silverfort, Ping Identity, and Microsoft Entra.

· Experience with developing, implementing, and configuring complex IT Security solutions.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Security concepts and principles (e.g. knowledge of SAML and OAuth).

· Strong programming and scripting skills (Java, PowerShell, JavaScript, Bash, etc.).

· Networking technologies and concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, routing, switching, firewalls).

· Virtualisation, Citrix, VMware.

· Cloud computing – AWS, Azure, Google, and hybrid environments.

· Windows Server/Active Directory/ADFS

· Linux (Red hat and/or SUSE), IOS, Android.


We are a focused team with highly experienced staff, a great offering, and you will be part of a growing team with a fun and positive culture. Whatever your goals, there will be plenty of room for career advancement as we grow. Remuneration will be commensurate with skills and experience. If this is the opportunity you have been waiting for, then we want to hear from you! Your resume will be assessed by our team, and if we feel that you could be a good fit, we will be in touch regarding the next steps.

Employer Name: PRASAD, SAJO - T/A Wings of Support
Phoenix Plaza, Unit B4/120 Konkerberry Drive, Kununurra, WA, 6743 Australia

JOB DESCRIPTION
Position: Marketing Specialist
Position Type: Full Time
Salary: $76,000 - $80,000 p/a plus Super
Employer Name: PRASAD, SAJO - T/A Wings of Support
A.B.N: 19 738 723 048
Job Location: Unit B4/120 Konkerberry Drive, Kununurra, Western Australia 6743. 

Summary
Our client Wings of Support is seeking to add a Marketing Specialist to their dedicated team in Kununurra. Since launching in 2023, Wings of Support has been committed to empowering NDIS participants in the East Kimberley region. With a strong client-centred approach and a focus on culturally responsive care, the organisation is expanding its outreach and visibility through strategic marketing efforts tailored to remote and regional communities.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:
•	Plan and execute marketing campaigns to promote support services and outreach initiatives.
•	Develop culturally appropriate content for print, digital, and multimedia platforms.
•	Manage website updates, email campaigns, and social media accounts regularly.
•	Design and produce flyers, brochures, and community-specific promotional materials.
•	Collaborate with community stakeholders to coordinate local engagement events.
•	Use NDIA and DHAC dashboards to analyse market trends and identify service gaps.
•	Monitor campaign performance using Google Analytics and Meta Ads Manager.
•	Create participant-focused stories and content aligned with NDIS and aged care reforms.
•	Support grant applications with case studies and marketing data insights.
•	Build relationships with ACCHOs, Elders, and local councils across the Kimberley.
•	Represent the organisation at community expos and local awareness events.
•	Track referral numbers, participant enquiries, and enrolment data as part of reporting.
•	Ensure marketing materials are accessible, easy to read, and culturally safe.
•	Use tools like Canva or Adobe Suite for graphic design and brand consistency.
•	Stay informed on aged care reforms and NDIS policy changes affecting outreach.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:
•	Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in marketing, communications or community engagement.
•	Experience designing culturally appropriate materials for Aboriginal and remote communities.
•	Demonstrated ability to manage integrated digital and print campaigns from concept to execution.
•	Proficiency in using Google Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, and Mailchimp for performance tracking.
•	Familiarity with NDIS or aged care systems and current reforms relevant to participant engagement.
•	Strong writing skills with an ability to tailor content for diverse audiences and formats.
•	Capacity to work independently in fast-paced environments with multiple projects and deadlines.
•	Willingness to travel across the Kimberley region for outreach and community-based events.

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful candidates will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.

How to apply:

Applications open on 3 July 2026 and close on 2 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.
